pairs.question: Quid stas, Luci, vel quid iam novissimum exspectas?
pairs.answer: Mors et haec acerbissima decreto latronum tibi comparata est.
pairs.derivation: Lucius (as ass) addresses himself: 'et ipse mecum:' framing dropped. He poses the question and answers it himself in the very next sentence, telling himself what he is waiting for / why he stands still: death prepared by the robbers. Answer cut at the first full stop; what follows ('Nec magno conatu res indiget; vides istas rupinas...') turns from answering to elaborating on how to die, so it is excluded.
